draft.text: I am announcing the release of my technical book, "From Token to Fleet," which details the architecture and scaling of LLM systems. The text systematically traces the execution path of a single token from initial memory allocation to distributed computation across a fleet of GPUs. It covers the specific scheduling algorithms, networking protocols, and hardware orchestration strategies required to build production-grade model infrastructure.
